data.one_liner: A plug-and-play mini arcade widget for Flutter apps when the device goes offline.
data.what_it_does: Detects network connectivity losses using HTTP pings and automatically offers users retro 8-bit mini-games (Breakout, Memory Match, Snake) via a drop-in widget wrapper. Includes multiple presentation modes, theme support, and standalone APIs for programmatic control.
use_when: You want to keep users entertained when your app loses internet connectivity.
You want built-in mini-games without heavy game engine dependencies.
avoid_when: Your application requires a full-fledged standalone game engine rather than simple connectivity mini-games.
Your app does not care about offline states or loss of connectivity.
strengths: Zero-config setup with a single line of code.
Zero heavy game engines or external font asset overhead.
Includes three built-in mini-games (Breakout, Memory Match, Snake).
weaknesses: Limited strictly to the pre-packaged set of retro arcade mini-games.
Not suitable for building complex custom non-arcade games.
data.setup_notes: No special native permissions or build runner steps required.
